**Tax Law Change Details**
Please provide information about the tax law change:

**Effective Date**
When does this change take effect?

**Source**
Please provide official sources:
- [ ] ACD (Administration des Contributions Directes)
- [ ] CCSS (Centre Commun de Sécurité Sociale)
- [ ] Government legislation
- [ ] Other: ___________

**Link to Official Documentation**
Provide links to official sources documenting this change.

**Type of Change**
What type of change is this?
- [ ] Tax brackets/rates
- [ ] Social security rates
- [ ] Tax credits (CIS, CI-CO2, CISSM)
- [ ] Deduction limits
- [ ] Family benefits
- [ ] Other: ___________

**Impact Assessment**
How does this affect calculations?
- [ ] Minor adjustment
- [ ] Significant calculation change
- [ ] New feature required
- [ ] Affects all users
- [ ] Affects specific scenarios only

**Detailed Description**
Provide a detailed description of what needs to be changed in the calculator.

**Test Cases**
If possible, provide example calculations that can be used to verify the implementation.

**Priority**
- [ ] Critical (affects current calculations)
- [ ] High (upcoming change)
- [ ] Medium (future planning)
- [ ] Low (minor adjustment)

**Additional Information**
Any other relevant information about this tax law change.
